How it answers

This is how the assistant will work once it is connected. Until then, Ask HAYKALAH stops after step 1 and shows you the passages it found, each with its source.

  1. 1It finds the passages. It searches HAYKALAH’s published pages in English and Arabic, from Expertise and Signature work to Insights, the Knowledge Center and the legal pages.
  2. 2An AI model writes the answer. The answer is generated by an AI model, Anthropic’s Claude, using only those passages from published HAYKALAH pages.
  3. 3Every answer shows numbered sources. Each point links to the page it came from, so you can read it in full.
  4. 4It says when it cannot answer. If our pages do not cover a question, it says so.
  5. 5It declines some questions. It does not comment on specific investments, returns or recommendations.
  6. 6A person is one step away. “Talk to a person” opens the request form.

Privacy

Ask HAYKALAH does not ask for your name or email. While the AI assistant is not connected, your question stays in your browser: it is matched against an index of our published pages on your device, and it is not sent to us or to anyone else. Once the assistant is connected, your question will be sent to the AI provider to generate the answer and logged without personal data, so please do not type personal or confidential information. We keep personal data only for as long as we need it for the purpose it was collected for, or as the law requires, and then delete it.

Read the privacy notice

Questions

Where do the answers come from?

Only from HAYKALAH’s published pages. While the AI assistant is not connected, Ask HAYKALAH shows the passages from those pages that best match your question, each with a numbered link to its source. Once it is connected, an AI model will write each answer from those passages.

Is Ask HAYKALAH investment advice?

No. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. Ask HAYKALAH declines questions about specific investments, returns or recommendations, and offers you a person instead.

What happens to my question?

While the AI assistant is not connected, your question stays in your browser. It is not sent to us or to anyone else, and it is not stored. Once the assistant is connected, it will be sent to the AI provider to generate the answer and logged without personal data; the privacy notice gives the details.

Can an answer be wrong?

Yes. Ask HAYKALAH is in Beta, and an answer can be incomplete or wrong. Check the sources it cites. Its answers do not bind HAYKALAH.
